title: Radiological Evaluation and Stratification of Childhood Lymphoma by Use of Expert AI
summary:
The RACOON-RESCUE study is a joint project of all university hospitals in the University Medicine Network (NUM) to develop new image-based parameters in the radiological diagnosis of paediatric non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (NHL). In Germany, around 160 children and adolescents are diagnosed with NHL every year. 
In RESCUE, new image-based risk features are to be identified and analysed with regard to their usefulness for risk stratification and prognostic significance. The project is based on previously collected image data and structured clinical data.
conditions: Other and unspecified types of non-Hodgkin lymphoma
